driver.lane_label: diagnostic: explicit unverified Trust lane (-Ztrust-verify=off for direct compiles, targo --unverified for builds); no Trust-verified compilation claim

cpu_policy.source: derived from each lane's compile command
cpu_policy.statement: Both lanes receive the identical trustc command except -Zcodegen-backend. No -C target-cpu / -C target-feature is passed: the LLVM lane compiles for the target's default CPU (llvm_default_target_cpu); the trust-cg lane selects instructions by its own per-target ISA profile (AArch64: AArch64IsaProfile::for_aot_target in crates/trust-cg-codegen/src/target.rs).

rss_sampling.method: getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss read by a single-child Python wrapper (benchmarks/beat-llvm/peak_rss.py) after the child is reaped, normalised to bytes; the largest single process in the measured tree, not a sum
rss_sampling.peak_rss_bytes: the compiled program: the median of N dedicated runs per lane (N = n_rss), lanes interleaved run by run, outside the timed loop
rss_sampling.compile_peak_rss_bytes: the compiler: the largest single process of the trustc invocation (trustc or its cc/ld link step); the median of N dedicated compiles per lane (N = n_rss), lanes interleaved compile by compile, outside the timed loop
rss_sampling.noise_policy: every reading is the exact median of an odd number of samples, each retained with its sampler status; a lane with any failed sample has no reading (never a median of the survivors); a program comparison's parity band is max(5%, 2 x the larger lane's relative sample spread (max-min)/median), and a comparison whose spread exceeds 0.25 is unresolved; evidence needs N >= 5
rss_sampling.gate: contract/gates.json version 3: R1 (fails if any program's bridge median exceeds max(its LLVM -O3 median, the floor) by more than its parity band; passes only when every program's comparison is resolved, above the floor and not noisy; otherwise unmeasured) and R2 (compiler peak-RSS geomean of medians <= 1.00x LLVM -O2, no floor-bound compiler reading); the program-RSS geomean is reported, not gated
rss_sampling.floor_rule: every reading is at least sampler_floor_bytes and one above it is the process's peak; a comparison is resolved only when both readings are above 2x sampler_floor_bytes

provenance.aggregation: median-of-N per program (compile N=3, run N=5 after 1 warmup, program and compiler peak RSS N=5); raw samples retained per program as times_s and rss_samples
provenance.size_definition: emitted-code size: bytes of the linked executable placed from object files the compile wrote into its own private output directory (codegen units and the allocator shim, not sysroot rlib members, system objects or linker-synthesized atoms), in code sections (__TEXT,__text / .text*) plus read-only data sections (__TEXT constants and literals, __DATA_CONST,__const / .rodata*, .data.rel.ro*), after dead stripping, as the linker's own map attributes them

proof_checker.order: aterm-packaged (PATH <prefix>/bin), then the driver's sysroot bin/clean
